newsitem.title: FINLAND: Huhtamaki adds late sweetener to Helsinki bull-run.
newsitem.headline: Huhtamaki adds late sweetener to Helsinki bull-run.

text.p: Shares powered to new highs in late Friday dealings as Huhtamaki surged almost 18 percent after saying it would swap its troubled U.S. confectionery unit for Hershey's European unit.

Late hectic trade in Huhtamaki took the HEX index, already probing new highs, further ahead to a new year high of 2,262.6 points and it closed at 2,259.51, up 1.05 percent, its highest since September 1995. Volume was a very lively 670 million markka.
Huhtamaki marched up 33.00 markka or nearly 18 percent to close at 218.00 markka, its highest in at least five years.

Nokia remained strong and lively following upbeat comments from CEO Jorma Ollila's comments in a Swiss newspaper on Wednesday, an enthusiastic rating for its Swedish rival Ericsson from Goldman Sachs and several big orders announced recently.
Data services group TT Tieto closed at a new 305.00 markka year-high, up 10 percent, on its acquisition of post and telecoms systems data provider Avancer, also in brisk dealings.
Compared to last Friday, the HEX ended 3.2 percent higher and brokers were encouraged particularly by the strong gains on Friday but some warned that the bull-run could soon be over.
"Looking down from these heights, vertigo is inevitable," said one.
